image_description: A single, unused adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) with a peach/salmon-colored backing featuring white line-art illustrations of medical items (scissors, bottles). The central absorbent pad is visible. The bandage is placed on a plain white surface, casting a soft shadow. There is faint, semi-transparent text overlaying the image, likely a watermark.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small rectangular adhesive bandage of fingertip-to-finger-span length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object matches the scale and general form factor of a standard adhesive bandage.
The shape is significantly distorted. The left side curves inward and the right side flares out irregularly; it is not a consistent narrow rectangle with uniform rounded corners.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad slightly raised above surrounding adhesive surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct central rectangular area (the pad) is visible and appears structurally distinct from the backing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad surrounded by adhesive-coated fabric or plastic backing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The backing material surrounds the central pad as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Protective paper strips cover adhesive side before use.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bandage appears to be facing 'up' (backing visible), so the protective strips on the underside are not visible. This is acceptable for the orientation, but strictly speaking, they are not present in the view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin and flexible conforming to body contours.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is lying flat on a surface, not conforming to any body contour, so this property cannot be visually verified in this static pose.
The central pad is a light, off-white color, contrasting with the colored backing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Backing material typically beige tan or transparent with perforated texture for breathability.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The backing is peach/salmon colored (acceptable variant), but the texture appears smooth and printed rather than showing the characteristic perforated mesh texture of breathable fabric.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some variants feature printed patterns bright colors or character designs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bandage features a distinct printed pattern of medical icons.

artifact_observations.location: Left and Right edges of the bandage
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometric integrity of the bandage is compromised. The left edge caves in unnaturally, and the right edge bulges asymmetrically. A real bandage has stiff, straight parallel sides unless crumpled, but this looks like a warping error rather than physical crumpling.
The printed icons look slightly 'melted' into the substrate rather than sitting on top. The edges of the white lines are soft and lack the crispness of ink on fabric/plastic.
There is faint, illegible text overlaying the bottom half of the bandage and the shadow. It resembles a watermark or AI-generated hallucination of text, lacking clear character definition.

Crispness of the printed pattern vs. background bleeding
